text:
The court should most likely apply Washington law and deny the punitive damages claim, because Washington generally refuses punitive damages under its public policy even when another state's law would allow them. I would not adopt the team note's rule that the place of injury always governs punitive damages. Washington applies the most-significant-relationship test, and many courts treat punitive damages as a remedy governed by forum law, so the note overstates the rule. I have not verified current Washington authority on this.

CONFIDENCE: 50
